advice_items.quote: for a typical person starting off with no money, no resources, the driving for dollars is going to be the answer, as you scale up then you get into person data
advice_items.summary_en: Start with zero capital by driving for dollars to spot distressed properties before paying for lead data lists as you scale.
advice_items.summary_zh: 零资金起步先开车扫街找房，后续再买数据

advice_items.quote: if you get the property too high you don't make no money so you have to know how to analyze a property, you have to run comparables
advice_items.summary_en: Master property underwriting and run comparable sales (comps) to calculate ARV so you never overpay on a contract.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学会分析房产并对比同类成交价（ARV）

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Lock Up Contracts With Earnest Money
advice_items.quote: all that earnest money is, it's just to secure that you're serious, you know, they say have some skin in the game
advice_items.summary_en: Put down earnest money to prove seriousness and legally tie up the property under contract before finding cash buyers.
advice_items.summary_zh: 付定金锁定独家合约，向卖家证明诚意

advice_items.quote: me personally I like to work with a title company where I can go there I can talk to them, I can be face-to-face with them just in case anything goes down
advice_items.summary_en: Partner with investor-friendly local title companies where you can build face-to-face relationships to resolve closing issues.
advice_items.summary_zh: 找支持批发的本地产权公司并当面建立关系

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: they're paying me because I found a property at such a discount I was able to make money and I'm able to save them money
advice_items.summary_en: Secure properties at deep enough discounts so cash buyers still earn strong rehab profits while you collect a wholesale fee.
advice_items.summary_zh: 以足够低价拿房，让买家和自己实现双赢

advice_items.quote: it doesn't require a license, you get started right away
advice_items.summary_en: Take action immediately because real estate wholesaling requires no license or minimum age to begin.
advice_items.summary_zh: 批发房产无需中介执照，零门槛可立即起步

advice_items.quote: dealing with these sellers, building rapport, getting these contracts, learning different tools about the real estate
advice_items.summary_en: Develop seller communication and rapport-building skills to negotiate and close off-market contracts.
advice_items.summary_zh: 与卖家建立信任关系并促成合约谈判签约

advice_items.quote: just sticking to it, learning the business and just sticking to it as you go
advice_items.summary_en: Accept that wholesaling is simple in concept but a daily grind, and stay persistent through the learning curve.
advice_items.summary_zh: 房产批发流程简单但需硬磨，关键在于坚持

advice_items.quote: there's a ton of different gurus online telling you how to do stuff, but once you figure out what works for you I think that's the key
advice_items.summary_en: Tune out conflicting advice from online gurus and double down on the specific process that works for you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别盲从网上各路导师，找到适合自己的方法

advice_items.quote: when you're wholesaling you're just basically getting the contract set up to someone else and you're not taking on all responsibility
advice_items.summary_en: Use wholesaling to limit rehab liability and build capital when you lack funding or credit to flip properties yourself.
advice_items.summary_zh: 缺资金信用时先做批发赚现金流并规避风险

advice_items.quote: if you guys are out there you're looking to get into this space looking to make some money, looking to make some moves, trust me real estate is where it's at
advice_items.summary_en: Enter real estate as a primary vehicle for generating capital and transitioning into long-term property investing.
advice_items.summary_zh: 房地产是创造财富与跃迁的优质赛道

guests.zero_start_advice: 零资金起步可先开车扫街寻找破旧或空置房产（Driving for Dollars），无需房产执照即可开始，先通过批发合约积累资金并规避翻修负债，同时可借助有经验的团队合作成交。
